subject.title: [Bug] LINE channel: messages not delivered + Markdown table/code block rendering broken

question: Which active LINE repair path should own this umbrella issue before it can close?
rationale: The issue combines multiple valid-looking LINE delivery and rendering problems, and automation cannot safely choose merge order, proof acceptance, or whether to split remaining symptoms after the open PRs.

options.title: Coordinate the active LINE PRs
options.body: Review the focused batching, formatting/payload, and retry/keepalive PRs, require live LINE proof or an explicit proof override, then close this issue only after the accepted fixes are on main.

options.title: Split the umbrella now
options.body: Close or narrow this issue only after creating or selecting separate canonical trackers for any symptoms not owned by the open PRs.

options.title: Reject the broad direction
options.body: Explicitly reject the combined delivery/rendering direction and close the related PRs/issues with the supported alternative behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate the active LINE PRs
recommendation.body: Review the focused batching, formatting/payload, and retry/keepalive PRs, require live LINE proof or an explicit proof override, then close this issue only after the accepted fixes are on main.

likelyOwner.reason: The related LINE delivery discussion asks for this maintainer's policy input, and history shows adjacent work around the same LINE/reply boundary.
